# Segment 1 (0-10.2s) - Introduction
title = Text("Reciprocal Trigonometric Identities", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Understanding inverse relationships", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.wait(5.2)

# Segment 2 (10.2-21.8s) - Importance and Sine/Cosecant intro
sine_eq = MathTex(r"\sin \theta").shift(LEFT * 3)
csc_eq = MathTex(r"\csc \theta").shift(RIGHT * 3)
arrow = Arrow(sine_eq.get_right(), csc_eq.get_left(), color=YELLOW)

self.play(
    FadeOut(subtitle),
    Write(sine_eq),
    Write(csc_eq),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Create(arrow), run_time=2)
self.wait(6.7)

# Segment 3 (21.8-37.6s) - Sine and Cosecant relationship
reciprocal1 = MathTex(r"\csc \theta = \frac{1}{\sin \theta}").scale(1.5)
box1 = SurroundingRectangle(reciprocal1, color=BLUE)

self.play(
    FadeOut(sine_eq, csc_eq, arrow),
    Write(reciprocal1),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Create(box1), run_time=2)
self.wait(10.7)

# Segment 4 (37.6-51.3s) - Cosine/Secant and Tangent/Cotangent
reciprocal2 = MathTex(r"\sec \theta = \frac{1}{\cos \theta}").next_to(reciprocal1, DOWN)
reciprocal3 = MathTex(r"\cot \theta = \frac{1}{\tan \theta}").next_to(reciprocal2, DOWN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(box1),
    reciprocal1.animate.scale(0.67).to_edge(UP, buff=2),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Write(reciprocal2), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(reciprocal3), run_time=2)
self.wait(7.7)

# Segment 5 (51.3-72.6s) - Summary and utility
summary_box = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(reciprocal1, reciprocal2, reciprocal3), 
                                 color=GOLD, buff=0.4)
summary_text = Text("These identities are fundamental\nfor trigonometric manipulation",
                   font_size=32).next_to(summary_box, DOWN)

self.play(
    Create(summary_box),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Write(summary_text),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(16.3)

# Segment 5 (65.5-84.3s) - Calculate hypotenuse

).arrange(DOWN).to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(Write(calc[3]), run_time=2)

# Segment 6 (84.3-97.5s) - Sine and Cosine

self.play(Write(cosine), run_time=3)

# Segment 7 (97.5-107.6s) - Cosecant and Secant

# Segment 8 (107.6-119.8s) - Cotangent

section_title: Proving Angle Equality from Sine Equality
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-11.7s) - Introducing triangles
# Create first triangle ABC
triangle_abc = Polygon(
    np.array([-3, -2, 0]), 
    np.array([-3, 1, 0]),
    np.array([-1, -2, 0]),
    color=BLUE
)
abc_labels = VGroup(
    Text("A").next_to(triangle_abc.get_vertices()[0], LEFT),
    Text("B").next_to(triangle_abc.get_vertices()[1], LEFT),
    Text("C").next_to(triangle_abc.get_vertices()[2], RIGHT)
)

# Create second triangle PQR
triangle_pqr = Polygon(
    np.array([1, -2, 0]),
    np.array([1, 1, 0]), 
    np.array([3, -2, 0]),
    color=RED
)
pqr_labels = VGroup(
    Text("P").next_to(triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[0], LEFT),
    Text("Q").next_to(triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[1], LEFT),
    Text("R").next_to(triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[2], RIGHT)
)

self.play(Create(triangle_abc), Create(triangle_pqr), run_time=5)
self.play(Write(abc_labels), Write(pqr_labels), run_time=4)
self.wait(2.7)

# Segment 2 (11.7-30.0s) - Stating the goal
goal_text = MathTex(
    r"\text{If }\sin B = \sin Q",
    r"\text{ then }B = Q"
).to_edge(UP)

self.play(Write(goal_text[0]), run_time=3)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(goal_text[1]), run_time=3)
self.wait(10.3)

# Segment 3 (30.0-49.2s) - Applying sine ratio
sine_ratio = MathTex(
    r"\sin B = \frac{AC}{AB} = \frac{PR}{PQ} = \sin Q"
).next_to(goal_text, DOWN)

self.play(Write(sine_ratio), run_time=4)
self.wait(15.3)

# Segment 4 (49.2-67.5s) - Introducing k ratio
k_ratio = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\frac{AC}{PR} = \frac{AB}{PQ} = k"),
    MathTex(r"AC = k \cdot PR"),
    MathTex(r"AB = k \cdot PQ")
).arrange(DOWN).next_to(sine_ratio, DOWN)

self.play(Write(k_ratio[0]), run_time=3)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(k_ratio[1]), Write(k_ratio[2]), run_time=3)
self.wait(10.3)

# Segment 5 (67.5-145.7s) - Pythagorean theorem and similarity
pyth_steps = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"BC^2 = AB^2 - AC^2"),
    MathTex(r"BC = k\sqrt{PQ^2 - PR^2}"),
    MathTex(r"QR = \sqrt{PQ^2 - PR^2}"),
    MathTex(r"\frac{BC}{QR} = k")
).arrange(DOWN).next_to(k_ratio, DOWN)

self.play(Write(pyth_steps[0]), run_time=5)
self.wait(10)
self.play(Write(pyth_steps[1]), run_time=5)
self.wait(10)
self.play(Write(pyth_steps[2]), run_time=5)
self.wait(10)
self.play(Write(pyth_steps[3]), run_time=5)

conclusion = Text(
    "Therefore, triangles ABC and PQR are similar\nand angle B = angle Q",
    font_size=36
).next_to(pyth_steps, DOWN)

self.play(Write(conclusion), run_time=5)
self.wait(23.2)

# Segment 1 (0-9.1s) - Introduction
title = Text("Evaluating Trigonometric Expressions", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=3)

# Segment 2 (9.1-19.8s) - Introducing Pythagorean identity

self.play(

    ReplacementTransform(title, expression),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(7.7)

# Segment 3 (19.8-34.0s) - Complete identity

    r"\cos^2(\theta) + \sin^2(\theta) = 1"
).scale(1.5)
complete_identity.move_to(ORIGIN)

self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(expression, complete_identity),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Indicate(complete_identity.get_part_by_tex("1"), color=YELLOW),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(10.2)

# Segment 4 (34.0-48.7s) - Swapped terms example

    r"\sin^2(\theta) + \cos^2(\theta) = 1"
).scale(1.5)
swapped_identity.move_to(ORIGIN)

self.play(

    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Indicate(swapped_identity, color=BLUE),
    run_time=2
)

# Segment 5 (48.7-67.5s) - Right triangle explanation

)
triangle.move_to(ORIGIN)

# Labels for triangle
hyp_label = MathTex("1").next_to(triangle.get_center(), UP + RIGHT, buff=0.3)

cos_label = MathTex(r"\cos(\theta)").next_to(triangle.get_bottom(), DOWN)

# Final identity below triangle

# Segment 1 (0-7.1s) - Intro to verifying identities
title = Text("Verifying Trigonometric Identities", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("A systematic approach", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)

# Segment 2 (7.1-19.8s) - Definition

                 font_size=32).shift(DOWN)

# Segment 3 (19.8-31.0s) - Introduce identity and triangle

identity = MathTex(r"\sin^2 \theta + \cos^2 \theta = 1").shift(UP)
triangle = Polygon(
    np.array([-2, -2, 0]),
    np.array([1, -2, 0]), 
    np.array([-2, 1, 0]),

)

self.wait(7.2)

# Segment 4 (31.0-47.7s) - Label triangle
x_label = MathTex("x").next_to(triangle, DOWN)
y_label = MathTex("y").next_to(triangle, LEFT)
r_label = MathTex("r").next_to(triangle.get_center(), UP+RIGHT)
theta = Arc(radius=0.5, start_angle=0, angle=PI/3, 
           arc_center=triangle.get_vertices()[0])
theta_label = MathTex(r"\theta").next_to(theta, RIGHT)

labels = VGroup(x_label, y_label, r_label, theta, theta_label)
ratios = MathTex(
    r"\sin \theta = \frac{y}{r}",
    r"\cos \theta = \frac{x}{r}"
).arrange(DOWN).next_to(triangle, RIGHT, buff=1)

self.play(
    Create(theta),
    Write(theta_label),
    Write(x_label),
    Write(y_label), 
    Write(r_label),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Write(ratios), run_time=3)
self.wait(10.8)

# Segment 5 (47.7-94.9s) - Verification steps
steps = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\sin^2 \theta + \cos^2 \theta = \left(\frac{y}{r}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{x}{r}\right)^2"),
    MathTex(r"= \frac{y^2}{r^2} + \frac{x^2}{r^2}"),
    MathTex(r"= \frac{y^2 + x^2}{r^2}"),
    MathTex(r"= \frac{r^2}{r^2} = 1")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(identity, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(Write(steps[0]), run_time=3)
self.wait(10)
self.play(Write(steps[1]), run_time=3)
self.wait(10)
self.play(Write(steps[2]), run_time=3)
self.wait(8)
self.play(Write(steps[3]), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.2)

# Segment 4 (52.3-78.7s) - Pythagorean theorem
pyth_eq = MathTex(r"AC^2 = AB^2 + BC^2").shift(UP*2)
calc_1 = MathTex(r"AC^2 = 3^2 + 4^2").next_to(pyth_eq, DOWN)
calc_2 = MathTex(r"AC^2 = 9 + 16 = 25").next_to(calc_1, DOWN)

# Segment 5 (78.7-120.8s) - All trig ratios
